inventory.source:
def inventory(bundle, include_clip=False):
    records = []
    seen = set()
    for script in bundle['scripts']:
        path = script['path']
        if path in seen:
            raise ValueError('ambiguous source script path: ' + path)
        seen.add(path)
        match = FRAME_ACTION.fullmatch(path)
        record = {'swf': bundle['game_file'], 'swf_sha256': bundle['swf_sha256'],
                  'path': path, 'source_sha256': hashlib.sha256(script['source'].encode()).hexdigest(),
                  'kind': 'DoAction' if match else 'other_action',
                  'sprite': int(match[1] or 0) if match else None,
                  'frame': int(match[2]) if match else None,
                  'instrumented': bool(match and bundle['game_file'] != 'game/main.swf')}
        clip = CLIP_ACTION.fullmatch(path) if include_clip else None
        if clip:
            record.update(kind='clip_action', sprite=int(clip[1] or 0), frame=int(clip[2]),
                          placement_path=clip[3], event=clip[4],
                          instrumented=bundle['game_file'] != 'game/main.swf')
        record['id'] = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(record, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()
        records.append(record)
    return records

callsite.interpretation: Reviewed fighter doAllAction handlers do not select this root property callback; call_after/end are inside their handler, not an outer dispatcher continuation.

body_callback.interpretation: Fighter-only wrapper around on_enterframe(); exit marks continuation after that inner call, still within the enclosing clip callback. Slot and coordinates do not identify an owner generation or activation.

replacement_dependency.interpretation: Every candidate emits via the property replaced at the closing guard. No independent replacement-surviving sink is established; no new execution is inferred.

loaded_body.requirement: Resolve executing body bytes to the archived callback, not merely a source/SWF hash.

owner_generation.requirement: Bind root owner lifetime, defining scope and closure generation across property replacement.

activation_entry.requirement: Observe entry with an invocation identity independent of shared tick/display and aiEvent.

dispatcher_return.requirement: Match that same invocation at the dispatcher continuation; distinguish return, unwind and termination.

observer_preservation.requirement: Qualify observer-off/on effects and retained observation after aiEvent replacement.

blocker: Retained candidates either do not select the root closure or observe its assignment/inner call, and all use the replaced aiEvent property. No independent loaded-body/owner-generation/activation-to-dispatcher-return facility has been established.
search_scope: Four retained source observer paths named in this report plus locked s314; not an exhaustive search for external facilities.
next_discriminator: Resolve one live loaded closure, owner/defining-scope generation and activation independently; match its entry with its dispatcher continuation through logger replacement and qualify off/on effects. Return, unwind and termination must remain distinct; done and closing invocations must not share an inferred identity.
